hooks.text: 每个生态区都是会清零的独立跑局，但收入会转换成星级用于永久便利性与能力升级
hooks.excerpt: Each biome you play is a "run" and after every run you start back from scratch. But you don't lose everything! Your money is converted into star rank which you can spend on upgrades that improve quality of life, or give you powerful new abilities.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 给魔法史莱姆投喂任意物品后，它们会以生成金币或攻击腐化等不同方式回报协助
hooks.excerpt: Ah, Gellis. These little guys are filled with magic energy and they'll eat anything you offer them. After a good meal they'll be more than happy to offer help in unique ways like conjuring a pile of coins, or attacking the corruption.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 种植既可等待自然生长也可主动点击加速，并通过种卖循环最终培育传奇作物
hooks.excerpt: Purchase some seeds, harvest them, and sell them to afford higher quality seeds. Not into sitting around watching crops grow? grow them faster by clicking near them! As you get better at farming you'll Eventually grow Legendary Crops that would make any farmer jealous.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
